turn: The deduplicated-notices CSV export now writes with a semicolon delimiter and a UTF-8 BOM, so Excel opens it with the right columns and accented characters intact. In `src/export_csv/writer.py`, `write_csv` opens the file with `utf-8-sig` and `newline=''`. It uses `csv.DictWriter` with `delimiter=';'` and `extrasaction='ignore'`, so extra fields on a record are dropped instead of raising an error. The columns are title, buyer, cpv, deadline, estimated_value, lot_number and lot_title. I haven't run the export or any tests in this session, so none of this is verified. The same commit also includes a small fix I noticed along the way: I added `newline=''` to the file open call, which stops blank lines appearing between rows on Windows. Next I'll start "Export duplicate groups as JSON Lines".

sidefix.title: Prevent blank rows in CSV output
sidefix.what: Opened the output file with newline='' so Windows doesn't insert blank lines between rows.
